title: Broadcast core mutations to the SSE event hub
description: From the 2026-08-15 complete code audit: `emitMutationEvent` (src/core/events.ts:5) is only ever called by the dashboard's own `emit()` wrapper (src/dashboard/server.ts:70). Core mutations (`createTask`, `claimTask`, `postMessage`, ...) append to events.jsonl but never publish to the in-process hub, so the dashboard's SSE live stream (src/dashboard/server.ts:639) misses CLI/MCP-driven changes. Fix: publish a typed event from the core write path (`appendEventUnlocked` or the mutation entry points) so all surfaces' mutations appear live, or explicitly document the limitation if a hub emission from core is rejected.
acceptance: A mutation performed outside the dashboard process surface (simulated via a direct core call) appears on the SSE /api/events stream.
The hub publish is best-effort and cannot throw out of the write path (mirrors events.ts:7-12).
Existing dashboard-only live updates keep working.
All checks green: `bun test`, `bun run typecheck`, `bun run check`, `waystation validate`.
notes: Reported as audit finding #7 (low). Touches src/core/store.ts, also touched by task-lock-contended-wiring and task-sweep-tmp-coverage; coordinate.
